headline: Bajaj Finserv reports March 2026 insurance business updates with steady premium growth
why_it_matters: General insurance gross direct premium grew to ₹23,178.51 Cr for FY26 from ₹21,416.80 Cr in FY25, reflecting steady core expansion.
Life insurance total new business premium rose to ₹14,585.82 Cr for FY26 compared to ₹12,292.58 Cr in FY25, driven by individual and group segments.
what_happened: Bajaj General Insurance reported Gross Direct Premium underwritten of **₹1,384.28 Cr** for March 2026 and **₹23,178.51 Cr** up to March 2026.
Bajaj Life Insurance reported total new business premium of **₹2,283.51 Cr** for March 2026 and **₹14,585.82 Cr** up to the period ended March 2026.

headline: UltraTech seeks shareholder nod for ₹9,820 Cr related-party transactions with The India Cements
why_it_matters: The proposed transactions of ₹9,820 crore represent 11.24% of the company's annual consolidated turnover for FY2025-26, making them material under SEBI Listing Regulations.

The transactions include purchase of goods and services up to ₹6,000 crore, sale of goods and services up to ₹2,150 crore, inter-corporate deposits up to ₹1,000 crore, and corporate guarantees up to ₹500 crore.
what_happened: UltraTech Cement has sought approval from members via **Postal Ballot** through remote e-voting for material related-party transactions with **The India Cements Limited**, its subsidiary, aggregating up to **₹9,820 crore** for FY2026-27.

The remote e-voting period commences on **Friday, 1st May, 2026** at 9:00 a.m. IST and ends on **Saturday, 30th May, 2026** at 5:00 p.m. IST, with results to be announced on or before **2nd June, 2026**.
**Mr. Anish Gupta**, Partner, VKMG & Associates LLP, has been appointed as the Scrutinizer for the postal ballot process.

headline: BEL wins ₹1,251 Cr Ground Based Electronic Warfare System order, over double its order book
why_it_matters: The order value of ₹1,251 crore is 219.9% of the company's FY27 order book in memory.
what_happened: BEL received an order valued at **₹1,251 crore** (excluding taxes) from the **Indian Army**.

headline: BEL wins ₹608 Cr defence orders
what_happened: **Bharat Electronics Limited** has received orders worth **₹608 Cr** from various defence sectors.

headline: Ceigall India Q1FY27 revenue rose 15.7% YoY to ₹970 Cr; EBITDA margin improved to 13.4%
why_it_matters: Revenue growth of 15.7% YoY in Q1FY27 exceeds the upper bound of the company's historical revenue growth guidance range of 10%-15%, indicating stronger-than-expected performance.
Management maintained full-year EBITDA margin guidance of 11%-12.5% despite Q1 margin of 13.4%, reflecting a conservative approach to forward-looking statements.
what_happened: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR970 crores as against INR838 crores in Q1 FY26, registering a 15.7% year-on-year growth.
Consolidated EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at INR121 crores as against INR94 crores in Q1 FY26, with EBITDA margin improving to 13.4% from 11.4% in Q1 FY26.

As on 30th June 2026, the order book stood at INR18,568 crores, providing strong multiple year revenue visibility across 19 EPC, 10 HAM, 1 DBFOT, and 9 tariff-based renewable and transmission projects.

headline: India Ratings withdraws rating on Balaji Amines' ₹195 Cr bank facilities on zero bank debt
why_it_matters: Demonstrates debt reduction from Q4FY26 gross debt of ₹132.91 Cr, leaving the company with no outstanding bank loan exposure.
The withdrawal was initiated upon the company's own request following full settlement and issuance of No Dues Certificates by all lenders.
what_happened: **India Ratings** withdrew ratings on the company's bank facilities after receiving No Dues Certificates confirming **zero outstanding bank exposure**.
The withdrawn rating applied to **₹195 Cr** (INR 1,950 million) of bank loan facilities, previously rated **IND AA/Negative/IND A1+**.

headline: ICRA upgrades HCL long-term rating to AAA (Stable) from AA+ on ₹2,100 Cr bank facilities; A1+ reaffirmed on ₹100 Cr CP
why_it_matters: One-notch upgrade to AAA (Stable), the highest long-term grade, on ₹2,100 Cr bank facilities equal to 62.8% of net worth may support borrowing terms; ICRA's rationale is pending.
Short-term A1+ reaffirmed on ₹100 Cr commercial paper (yet to be placed) and bank facilities, keeping near-term liquidity rating unchanged.
Peer Jindal Stainless was upgraded to CARE AA+ on 25 Aug 2026; HCL's move to AAA places it a notch above that peer tier.
what_happened: ICRA upgraded Hindustan Copper's long-term rating to **[ICRA]AAA (Stable)** from **[ICRA]AA+ (Stable)** on **₹2,100 Cr** bank facilities/instruments.
Short-term rating **[ICRA]A1+** reaffirmed on **₹2,100 Cr** bank facilities and on **₹100 Cr** commercial paper (yet to be placed).
Total rated amount **₹2,200 Cr** spans term loan, cash credit, non-fund-based limits, unallocated limits and commercial paper.
